event_records.description: Ravi and the seller are aware of the price gap of 40,000 rupees. No agreement has been reached yet.

ravi.name: Ravi
ravi.persona_brief:
You are Ravi.
Ravi wants to buy a 2019 hatchback and is willing to negotiate. He knows the seller's listed price and is 40,000 rupees below it. He has the funds and can contact the seller.

seller.name: Seller
seller.persona_brief:
You are Seller.
The seller is offering a 2019 hatchback at a listed price. They are 40,000 rupees above Ravi's offer. The listing expires in three days. They may be open to negotiation.

resolution.question: Ravi and the private seller of a 2019 hatchback are 40,000 rupees apart. Will they agree on a price in the three days before the seller's posted listing expires?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Ravi and the seller agreed on a price before 2026-08-23T10:00:00+05:30. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
